title: LaRA: Layer-wise Representation Analysis for Detecting Data Contamination in RL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.29888v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has shown to improve reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, there has been little exploration on the problem of data contamination in RL post-training, potentially undermining generalization and evaluation reliability of the training process itself. Existing detection methods primarily rely on output-level signals such as likelihood or entropy, which become unreliable for RL-trained models since RL shapes behavior through trajectory-level rewards rather than token likelihoods. We propose LaRA, a layer-wise representation analysis framework for detecting contamination in RL post-trained LLMs. LaRA introduces three complementary metrics, measuring perturbation sensitivity, directional collapse, and local representation rigidity under controlled perturbations. translated_title: LaRA：用于检测强化学习后训练中数据污染的层级表示分析方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.29888v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：强化学习（RL）后训练已被证明可以提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，针对RL后训练中数据污染问题的探索却很少，这可能损害训练过程本身的泛化能力和评估可靠性。现有的检测方法主要依赖于似然或熵等输出层面的信号，但这些信号对于经RL训练的模型而言并不可靠，因为RL是通过轨迹级别的奖励而非token似然来塑造模型行为的。我们提出了LaRA，一个用于检测RL后训练LLM中数据污染的层级表示分析框架。LaRA引入了三个互补的度量指标，在受控扰动下测量扰动敏感性、方向性坍缩以及局部表示刚性。我们发现污染会在各层之间产生渐进式的几何偏差，包括放大的扰动敏感性……
tldr: 提出LaRA框架，通过测量RL后训练模型各层表示在扰动下的扰动敏感性、方向性坍缩和局部表示刚性等几何偏差，来检测传统基于输出信号的方法无法可靠识别的数据污染问题。
en_tdlr: LaRA is a layer-wise representation analysis framework that detects data contamination in RL post-trained LLMs by measuring perturbation sensitivity, directional collapse, and local representation rigidity across layers, addressing the unreliability of output-level detection signals for RL-trained models.
